difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that flatness at a point of a morphism of algebraic stacks is equivalent to flatness of the induced map of local rings at corresponding points, expressed through presentations (author lemma at source lines 5498-5524, label lemma-flat-at-point). The proof (source lines 5526-5559) compares the local rings of the stack and of a presentation, applies the corresponding criterion for algebraic spaces and uses the locality of flatness in the smooth topology to conclude (proof lines 5526-5558). The comparison of local rings through a presentation is the substance. H3.
